evidence.title: LINE Design System for Global Family Service

name: Components — LINE Design System
summary: 35 documented UI components from LINE's design system: buttons, tabs, badges, inputs, navbars, drawers, toasts and more.
description: The components section of LINE's design system guide (LDSG). It lists 35 component documentation pages for LINE's apps — action and icon buttons, tags, badges, page indicators, checkboxes, pulldown menus, sliders, switches, text inputs, footers, side drawers, bottom sheets, expanded tab lists and toasts, among others — each with its own reference page.
